proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k p hij hik hjk
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {i, j, k} := by decide +revert
  have h0 : (t.points i -ᵥ t.centroid) + (t.points j -ᵥ t.centroid) + (t.points k -ᵥ t.centroid) = (0 : V) := by
    have h := Affine.Simplex.eq_centroid_iff_sum_vsub_eq_zero.mp (rfl : t.centroid = t.centroid)
    rwa [hu, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hjk]), Finset.sum_singleton, ← add_assoc] at h
  have key : ∀ Q : P, dist p Q ^ 2 = dist p t.centroid ^ 2 - 2 * inner ℝ (p -ᵥ t.centroid) (Q -ᵥ t.centroid) + dist t.centroid Q ^ 2 := by
    intro Q
    rw [dist_eq_norm_vsub V p Q, dist_eq_norm_vsub V p t.centroid, dist_comm t.centroid Q, dist_eq_norm_vsub V Q t.centroid,
      ← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right p Q t.centroid, norm_sub_sq_real]
  have hi : inner ℝ (p -ᵥ t.centroid) (t.points i -ᵥ t.centroid) + inner ℝ (p -ᵥ t.centroid) (t.points j -ᵥ t.centroid) + inner ℝ (p -ᵥ t.centroid) (t.points k -ᵥ t.centroid) = 0 := by
    rw [← inner_add_right, ← inner_add_right, h0, inner_zero_right]
  rw [key (t.points i), key (t.points j), key (t.points k)]
  linear_combination -2 * hi
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3) (p : P), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → dist p (t.points i) ^ 2 + dist p (t.points j) ^ 2 + dist p (t.points k) ^ 2 = dist t.centroid (t.points i) ^ 2 + dist t.centroid (t.points j) ^ 2 + dist t.centroid (t.points k) ^ 2 + 3 * dist p t.centroid ^ 2
